correctness.rationale: Volume-uniform sampling factorizes into a disk and an interval. Independently averaging the squared disk difference using complex coordinates gives its j-th moment as R^(2j) times sum_i binom(j,i)^2/[(i+1)(j-i+1)]; the triangular interval law gives 2H^(2j)/[(2j+1)(2j+2)]. Exact rational expansion and coefficient comparison reproduced the moment polynomials, elimination identity, denominator minimum and both rational witness values. On 0<v/s<1 the normalized second moment is 45/31+(31/15)(v/s−10/31)^2; at 45/31 one preimage is attained, at 5/3 the second preimage is excluded by v=0, and 12/5 is not attained. The elimination identity makes m3 affine in v on each two-moment fiber with nonzero slope 3Q/13454. This proves the inverse and the sharp branch separation (the infimum is approached as the two distinct roots coalesce). Necessity is for the first two consecutive even moments; this is not a noisy-data bound or a claim about every choice of two statistics. RESULT.md §§1–4 and VERIFICATION.md were checked; the packaged simulations are corroboration only.
